dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Take any character penned by any playwright from any point in history, and you'll find that not a single one of them fulfilled their destiny without first enduring many trials and tribulations.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Though the road ahead is treacherous, fear not.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: With the aid of our companions, and our wills united as one, we can surely overcome any obstacle.
